name: Kaggle

sources.title: Kaggle Login or Register — 'Register with Google' / 'Register with Email' (content read via search index; direct fetch returns a JS-only shell)
Getting Started on Kaggle — platform docs (via search index)

requirements: Free account — register with Google or with Email
Kaggle is an ML community: public value comes from a profile, public datasets, notebooks, and discussion posts — there is no product-listing form
New accounts have a progression track (run a notebook, join a conversation, upvote, make a competition submission) that unlocks full participation
preparation: Email or Google account for registration
Profile details: display name, bio, website/URL field
A relevant public dataset or notebook if publishing content rather than just a profile
workflow: Register with Google or Email and complete profile setup
Add the product/company URL to the profile website field and fill the bio
Optionally publish a public dataset/notebook referencing the product to create an indexable artifact
Complete beginner tasks (notebook run, discussion comment, upvote, competition submission) to unlock full account standing
watchFor: Site is fully JS-rendered — direct fetch returns empty; browser automation required
This is a profile/community route, not a directory — don't expect a product listing page
Spammy self-promotion in discussions/notebooks violates community norms; keep the link to profile fields and genuinely useful artifacts
Link attribute on profile/dataset outbound links unverified
countsAsLive: A public kaggle.com/<username> profile with the website field populated (and any published datasets/notebooks visible)
unknowns: Whether profile website links are followed or nofollow
Exact new-account restrictions before full posting is unlocked
Whether phone verification is required at registration
